profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer | Java | Spring Boot | Kubernetes | AWS | GCP | AZURE | Distributed Systems | Cloud Architecture | 25+ Years Building Enterprise Software
profile.summary:
I am a Staff Software Engineer with more than 25 years of experience designing, building, and modernizing enterprise software for global organizations across financial services, healthcare, cloud infrastructure, and enterprise software.

Throughout my career, I have worked in Brazil, Poland, and the United States, partnering with globally distributed teams to deliver scalable, reliable, and high-performance systems. My experience spans the entire software lifecycle—from architecture and backend development to cloud platforms, production support, and technical leadership.

My primary technical expertise includes:

• Java & Spring Boot
• Kubernetes (EKS & GKE)
• AWS & Google Cloud Platform
• Distributed Systems & Microservices
• Kafka, RabbitMQ & Event-Driven Architectures
• REST APIs
• SQL & NoSQL Databases
• CI/CD & DevOps
• Cloud-native Applications

Earlier in my career I led engineering and production support teams within global investment banking organizations, where I developed strong leadership, mentoring, and stakeholder management skills. Today I combine that leadership experience with deep technical expertise to help engineering teams solve complex architectural challenges while continuing to contribute as a hands-on engineer.

I enjoy building scalable software, improving engineering practices, mentoring other engineers, and solving complex technical problems. I am always interested in opportunities where technology, collaboration, and innovation come together to create meaningful business impact.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Full-Stack Senior software engineer working on a project for Foundation Medicine developing and maintaining the application responsible to generate reports for cancer patients based on their genomic profile in order to identify therapy, trial and scientific text content for the patient's oncologist better decide the best possible treatment. 
The application runs on AWS cloud containers and it uses Java, Spring boot and Postgres on the back-end, plus React on the front-end.
positions.insights: Skills: Troubleshooting · Mockito · Code Review · Design Documents · Continuous Integration (CI) · Distributed Systems · Microservices · Technical Design

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.description:
Full-Stack Senior developer working on a project to develop a new dashboard for portfolio analysis to be used by Risk Management team on decision making about their client's portfolio.  
The solution is based on Java 8, Spring boot, Hibernate, SQL Server providing a REST API on the back-end and Angular, Highcharts and other javascript frameworks for the front-end.

positions.description: Senior Java developer working on a project to develop a new version of the Home broker web application used by the investment bank clients. On the technical side we use Spring, JSF, Hibernate and Oracle along with external interfaces to stock exchange.

positions.title: Project Leader

Production Support Analyst: part of the BDE support team which was responsible to provide support for the BDE application (HSBC's web content management tool). This is a global team which provides support to all regions of the globe using BDE to manage the content of their web portal.

Technologies used: Unix, SQL, Websphere portal server, Websphere application server.
